resources.string: Run apps on a separate Android display
Install a compatible plugin from a trusted developer, then return here to enable it.

Obtain a compatible APK from its developer and install it with Android. Return to WheelPlay and refresh this list. Open the plugin settings to finish setup and permissions, then enable and connect it.
Project Android Auto from this device. First-time setup is required.
Connect to the Head Unit Server on another phone by IP address.
Audio plays on this device. Microphone input follows the Android microphone setting; browser microphone input is not supported.
Connect to an existing VNC server on your local network or VPN.
Waiting for the browser window size. Open the WebUI to continue.
CarLife did not become ready in time.
CarLife cleanup could not be confirmed. Force stop WheelPlay in Android settings, then reopen it before connecting again.
Use this phone’s system CarLife feature to project to the car browser.
Receive CarLife from another phone on the same Wi-Fi network.

Connect opens the system car connection settings. Start CarLife wireless connection, then return to WheelPlay to continue automatically. On vivo, dismiss the Bluetooth check with Cancel if shown. If the system entry cannot be opened, use the preparation screen for manual setup.
Connect both phones to the same Wi-Fi network. Start CarLife wireless connection on the source phone, then select it on the preparation screen. If discovery fails, enter its IP address manually.
After connecting, open the WheelPlay address in the car browser to view and control the projection. Protocol options and connection history are available in Connection settings and diagnostics.
Receive CarLife over a USB / OTG data cable.
The receiver needs USB Host / OTG support. Connect one unlocked source phone, allow USB access and confirm CarLife on the source. Replug the cable if reconnecting fails.
